about: What changed in IPMA's "Weather warnings, up to 3 days" between one of our reads and the next: counts, and up to 40 examples of each kind. "at" is when we read the new version; "last_modified" is IPMA's own header on it. The full responses of both are in the data store under the hour read. Newest first; the last 60 are kept here.
